script.title: Why Kwality Wall's Lost ₹17 Cr Despite 44% Sales #shorts
script.hook_text: Selling More Ice Cream, Losing Crores?

segments.text: Kwality Wall's sold 44% more ice cream recently, yet reported a ₹17 crore net loss.
segments.broll: hands holding ice cream cone close up

segments.text: How does a famous brand sell millions more frozen treats while profits completely melt away?
segments.broll: melting ice cream bar slow motion
broll_alt: dripping ice cream cone close up

segments.text: In India, selling ice cream isn't just milk and sugar; it’s mostly expensive cold-chain logistics.
Powering thousands of street freezers and paying heavy quick-commerce delivery commissions eats up every single rupee.

broll_alt: hand picking ice cream packet freezer
street vendor push cart evening aerial

segments.text: Add surging dairy prices into the mix, and massive revenue growth turns directly into deep red numbers.
